changes.after: The [current 一体之仁 account](NONINSTRUMENTAL-CONCERN.md#一体之仁的生成解释) develops undergoing, understanding and response as mutually shaping within a continuing history. It retains unrecognized undergoing, actual experiential change through interpretation, revision or cessation after fulfillment, flourishing and differentiated refusal. The proposed noninstrumental ground concerns what the transformation actually does there, before private adoption; its constitutive warrant and universal reach remain substantive questions. This positive articulation places the local contracts below within a changing relationship rather than treating their independent predicates as a mandatory ontology.

changes.after: **一体之仁的共同形成，2026年10月6日：** [当前正面解释](NONINSTRUMENTAL-CONCERN.md#一体之仁的生成解释)将承受、理解与回应放回同一持续历程。理解可真实改变承受，回应可改变需要与后续理解；无人注意、拒绝某个手段或当前报告消失均不自动取消实际发生。仁的内容包括修正、停止、减少控制及支持成全。它要求模型保留相关中间后果与实际接续；这种表示要求和非工具性根据的构成论证各有范围，不能互相冒充完成证明。

changes.before: **Recipient consequence → supported continuation, 6 October 2026:** the [generative-health continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/RECIPIENT-CONTINUATION.md) applies the existing liquidity result to an independently specified recipient activity, preserving actual delivery, separate accounts, timing and nonresource conditions. The advance is an adequacy contract for interpreting consequences, not a new mechanism or recipient physiology. It supplies the consequence side of the next shared connection: affected continuation → acquired distinction → warranted revision of practice or criterion. Formation, identification and ethical grounding remain explicit obligations.
changes.after: **Recipient consequence → supported continuation → scope of correction, 6 October 2026:** the [correspondence analysis](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/RECIPIENT-CONTINUATION.md) now connects to a [source-level prefix result](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/CONTINUITY-AND-CORRECTION.md). Every existing service-access continuation from the actual four-pair state includes recipient stock 34 after starting at 36. An independently warranted continuous-floor application above 34 is consequently incompatible with every such path, despite favorable evaluation and possible later refunds. Reweighting unchanged paths cannot meet that joint requirement; a prospective advance-buffer bound addresses one specific liquidity condition without implementing delivery. This identifies the scope of a needed correction under fixed premises, not a recipient realization, new simulation, machine-certified theorem or universal ethical proof. The next bridge remains acquisition of the relevant consequence and justified, enactable revision of the obstructing relation.

changes.before: **Recipient consequence and supported continuation, 6 October 2026:** the [generative-health extension](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/RECIPIENT-CONTINUATION.md) specifies when an actual delivered resource change enables an independently identified recipient activity. A corollary of the existing prefix theorem gives the exact threshold under unchanged path increments and nonliquidity guards. It separates this enabling effect from execution, welfare and justified concern, and retains renewal and plasticity as distinct histories. This supplies the consequence-side correspondence for affected continuation → acquired distinction → warranted practice/criterion revision. No new controller, empirical run or completed recipient realization is claimed.
changes.after: **Recipient continuation and the scope of correction, 6 October 2026:** the [correspondence study](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/RECIPIENT-CONTINUATION.md) now leads to an [exact source-level obstruction](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/CONTINUITY-AND-CORRECTION.md). From the reached four-pair continuing state, every service-access path includes recipient stock 36→34 before any refund. Under an independently established prefix-floor requirement above 34, selection among unchanged paths cannot preserve that continuation and reach service. A path-specific advance-buffer bound identifies one prospective correction condition; delivery is not implemented. Separate source and philosophical reviews preserve the distinction between modeled stock, actual support, ethical warrant and realized revision. No new simulation or Lean certification is claimed; next is acquired consequence → warranted, enactable revision of the obstructing relation.

changes.before: **What delivered support enables, 6 October 2026:** the [recipient-continuation analysis](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/RECIPIENT-CONTINUATION.md) sharpens the proposed generative core through an independently identified activity, actual support and executable continuation. It reuses the established resource theorem while distinguishing enabled capacity, performed activity, lived consequence and justified response. This advances the consequence-side interface to shared concern without turning continuation into a universal welfare score.
changes.after: **Supported continuation and correction, 6 October 2026:** the [recipient correspondence](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/RECIPIENT-CONTINUATION.md) and [new prefix analysis](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-health/succession/CONTINUITY-AND-CORRECTION.md) show why an eventual return may fail an independently specified continuity requirement. When every available response path violates that requirement, correction must change the obstructing relation or revise the adequacy claim. The existing learner already favors service; its access protocol remains restrictive. This sharpens the relation between consequence and correction without asserting recipient physiology, universal ethical necessity or an implemented self-revision.
